title: Royal Guard's Series
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|"Royal Guard's Gear" redirects here. For the [[Side Quest]], see "[[The Royal Guard's Gear]]."}} {{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Royal Guard's Shield Icon.png |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= {{List| * [[Royal Gear]] * [[Royal Guard Set]] }} |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Royal Guard's Series|Royal Guard's Series|Series, BotW}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|Though Hyrule Castle was destroyed 100 years ago, somewhere inside it still sleeps rare equipment from those days. It is famed among collectors as the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard's series}}. Parcy, a traveler at the stable, wants nothing more than to see one of them.

However, the castle is a dangerous place nowadays, and ordinary folk risk their lives getting close...|The Royal Guard's Gear|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== The Royal Guard's Series is a set of equipment made for the [[Royal Guard]]s, and can be found at [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]]. The Series is built similarly to the [[Royal Gear]], but instead features hints of [[Sheikah]] design with black metals and highlights of deep red. It has the highest attack power of all the equipment used by the [[Soldier]]s of [[Hyrule]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} The Royal Guard's Series was designed and forged by the Sheikah with [[Ancient Technology]] in preparation of the foretold second [[Great Calamity]].{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Guard's Sword}}
A Sheikah-made replica of the sword that seals the darkness. It was made with ancient technology to oppose the Great Calamity, but its low durability made it inefficient.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Guard's Claymore}}
The Sheikah used the very essence of ancient technology to forge this greatsword. It was designed to oppose the Calamity, but its low durability made it impractical in battle.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Guard's Spear}}
This Sheikah-made spear was created using ancient technology to combat the Calamity. Its attack power is very high, but a critical design flaw left it with poor durability.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Guard's Bow}}
This prototype Sheikah-made bow was designed to fight the Great Calamity. Made with ancient technology, it boasts a high rate of fire and firepower but has low durability.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Royal Guard's Shield}}
This shield was forged using ancient Sheikah technology. It boasts extremely high stopping power, but its structural weakness made its low durability impractical for combat.|Inventory|BotW}} The [[Item]]s attempted to emulate the power of the [[Master Sword]], resulting in the high power that each item in the Series boasts. However, flaws in the designs of these Weapons left the Royal Guard's Series faulted with low durability, which makes them impractical for serious combat. Within Hyrule Castle are two of every Item in the Royal Guard's Series, which reappear after each [[Blood Moon]]. Surrounding Hyrule Castle is one of each Item inside [[Treasure Chest]]s, but they do not respawn. [[Parcy]], a [[Hylian]] traveler who resides at the [[Riverside Stable]], often snuck her way into Hyrule Castle in search of the Royal Guard's Series.{{Cite|Have you gone to the giant castle north of here? That's Hyrule Castle. It's said to have fallen to ruin over a hundred years ago. I used to sneak in there to salvage ancient treasures, but it's too dangerous to go in there now. These days it's surrounded by an eerie mist and savage machine-like creatures.|Parcy|BotW}} However, she was unable to find any of the Items in the Series.{{Cite|Back when it was safer, I went in looking for this ultra-rare equipment that once belonged to the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard}}. It's legendary among collectors, but I was never able to find any...|Parcy|BotW}} If [[Link]] speaks to her, she will task him with "[[The Royal Guard's Gear]]" [[Side Quest]].{{Cite|Though Hyrule Castle was destroyed 100 years ago, somewhere inside it still sleeps rare equipment from those days. It is famed among collectors as the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard's series}}. Parcy, a traveler at the stable, wants nothing more than to see one of them.

However, the castle is a dangerous place nowadays, and ordinary folk risk their lives getting close...|Adventure Log|BotW}} As part of this Quest, Link is asked to infiltrate Hyrule Castle and retrieve any item within the Royal Guard's Series to show to Parcy. If Link succeeds, she will reward him with a [[Gold Rupee]], completing the Side Quest.{{Cite|This is...incredible.|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Thank you. You have shown me something truly spectacular. I need to go out and find one of these myself.|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Here's a token of my appreciation.|Parcy|BotW}} At any point after this, Link can trade one of these Items with Parcy in exchange for a [[Gem]].{{Cite|Will you trade it for a topaz?|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Will you trade it for a sapphire?|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Will you trade it for a ruby?|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Will you trade it for a diamond?|Parcy|BotW}} All pieces of the Royal Guard's Series is constructed with metal, which means that they will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
